description: Department of Local Government - North Central Province - Calling Meeting of Elect New Vice Chairman for Thirappane Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces a meeting for the election of a Vice Chairman for a local authority (Thirappane Pradeshiya Sabha), which falls under electoral processes for local government bodies. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifies the date, time, and location for the election meeting, making it clearly related to election administration.
